name: Mental Maths Foundations
description: A high-utility mental-maths deck covering number bonds, complements, bridging through 10 and 100, left-to-right addition, compensation, counting up, doubles, near-doubles, double-and-half, and method-selection practice. It teaches when a method is appropriate, not just the final shortcut.
estimatedTime: 150–210 minutes for a first focused pass; then short daily review sessions

name: Mental Maths: Multiplication Foundations — Tables, Anchors & Transformations
description: A KaTeX-enabled mental-arithmetic deck that develops multiplication fluency through high-value table anchors, extension facts through 20, reverse fact families, doubling and halving, special multipliers, factor pairing, estimation, error detection, and method selection. It teaches students when a transformation is genuinely useful rather than presenting tricks as universal.
estimatedTime: 150–190 minutes for the first pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 2-Digit Addition
description: A focused mental-arithmetic deck for adding two 2-digit numbers. It teaches and drills left-to-right addition, carry handling, bridge-through-10, make-100, compensation, near-doubles, estimation, error detection, and method selection.
estimatedTime: 90–120 minutes for the first pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 2-Digit Subtraction
description: A focused KaTeX-enabled mental-arithmetic deck for subtracting two-digit numbers. It develops direct place-value subtraction, borrowing, bridge-to-ten, compensation, counting up, complements to 100, estimation, error detection, and strategy selection.
estimatedTime: 100–130 minutes for the first pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 3-Digit Subtraction
description: A KaTeX-enabled mental-arithmetic deck for subtracting three-digit numbers. It teaches left-to-right chunking, regrouping as place-value trading, multiple boundary crossings, across-zero subtraction, compensation, counting up, complements to 100/500/1000, estimation, error detection, and strategy selection.
estimatedTime: 130–170 minutes for the first pass; then 10–15 minute mixed review sessions

name: Mental Maths: 2-Digit × 1-Digit Multiplication
description: A KaTeX-enabled mental-arithmetic deck for multiplying a two-digit number by a one-digit number. It develops distributive multiplication, carrying through full partial products, multiplier-specific methods, nearby-base shortcuts, estimation, error detection, and strategy selection.
estimatedTime: 130–160 minutes for the first pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 3-Digit × 1-Digit Multiplication
description: KaTeX-enabled practice for three-digit by one-digit multiplication: chunking, full partial products, doubling, ×5, ×9, nearby bases, estimation, error checks, and strategy selection.
estimatedTime: 140–175 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 3-Digit × 2-Digit Multiplication — Core & Friendly Factors
description: A KaTeX-enabled deck for three-digit by two-digit multiplication. It develops reliable one-factor splitting, nearby-tens adjustments, friendly factors such as 25, 50, 75, 99, 101, 125, and 250, plus estimates, error checks, and method selection.
estimatedTime: 175–220 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–20 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 3-Digit × 3-Digit Multiplication — Structure & Strategy
description: A KaTeX-enabled advanced deck for structured three-digit multiplication. It distinguishes genuinely mental-friendly cases from arbitrary calculations, covering core chunking, friendly factors, near-1000 methods, difference of squares, estimates, limitations, and error checks.
estimatedTime: 180–230 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–20 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: Fast Multiplication — 5, 25, 50 & 125
description: KaTeX-enabled multiplication practice for the high-value factors 5, 25, 50, and 125. It teaches exact transformations, splitting for awkward inputs, factor pairing, powers-of-ten anchors, estimation, and method selection.
estimatedTime: 140–180 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: Fast Multiplication — 9, 11, 12, 15, 18, 19, 99 & 101
description: KaTeX-enabled practice for nearby-base multiplier patterns. It covers safe methods for 9, 11, 12, 15, 18, 19, 99, and 101; the limits of the ×11 digit shortcut; correction discipline; estimation; and error detection.
estimatedTime: 150–185 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: Square Numbers — Core Facts \(1^2\) to \(30^2\)
description: A KaTeX-enabled square-number deck with instant recall through 30², reverse square-root facts, next-square reconstruction, odd-difference patterns, base methods around 10/20/25/30, last-digit rules, and mixed practice.
estimatedTime: 150–190 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 2-Digit × 2-Digit Multiplication — Core Methods
description: KaTeX-enabled practice for the dependable default in two-digit multiplication: one-factor distributive splitting. It also includes area expansion, friendly tens, special factors, estimates, error checks, and mixed method selection.
estimatedTime: 170–210 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–20 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: Squares Ending in 5
description: A KaTeX-enabled deck for the high-value square-ending-in-5 method. It covers the algebraic reason behind the shortcut, two- to four-digit examples, reverse recognition, common traps, estimation, and mixed mastery practice.
estimatedTime: 130–170 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–15 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: 2-Digit × 2-Digit — Near Bases & Difference of Squares
description: KaTeX-enabled advanced multiplication practice for products near 10, 50, and 100; balanced products; and the same-tens-units-sum-to-10 pattern. It teaches conditions, padding, carry handling, limits, errors, and method selection.
estimatedTime: 170–220 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–20 minute review bursts

name: Mental Maths: Squares Near 10, 50, 100 & 1000
description: A KaTeX-enabled square-method deck based on \((B\pm d)^2\). It teaches squaring around standard and custom friendly bases, estimation, error checks, base selection, and mixed strategy practice.
estimatedTime: 170–220 minutes for a first focused pass; then 10–20 minute review bursts
